title.en: What a learner can learn through its registration

statement.zh: 所识的未来相同的配置给每个学习者同样的记录。被列表所持的世界中，某个学习者在每个配置上于目标静止，恰当这样的配置其目标从某步起一致；律使每个配置不变时，恰当目标经识同去。
statement.en: Configurations with the same registered future give every learner the same record. In a world a list holds, some learner rests on a target everywhere exactly where such configurations have targets agreeing from some step on; under a still law, exactly where it goes alike across the registration.

laws.zh: 学习者从所识的记录主张目标：由配置出发之轨道的所识历程（course）；从第 T 步起每步主张目标即从 T 起静止（RestsFrom），某个 T 存在即静止（Rests）。
laws.en: A learner claims a target from the registered record: the registered course of a configuration's orbit (course); claiming the target at every step from T on is resting from T (RestsFrom), and resting is resting from some T (Rests).

laws.zh: 所识的未来相同的两个配置给每个学习者每一步同样的记录；所以在其目标不同之步，主张至多在一处对，不用判定；目标值可判定时，主张在一处被否证，而两处记录处处相同。
laws.en: Two configurations with the same registered future give every learner the same record at every step; so at a step where their targets differ a claim is right on at most one, with no decision, and with the target values decided a claim is refuted on one while the two records stay equal at every step.

laws.zh: 在两处都静止的学习者，其目标从某步起一致；所以目标在任意晚处不同时，没有学习者在两处都静止；律使两个配置不变、识不分辨它们而目标不同时即如此。
laws.en: A learner resting on both has targets agreeing from some step on; so where they differ at arbitrarily late steps no learner rests on both, already where the law leaves both configurations unchanged, the registration does not tell them apart and their targets differ.

laws.zh: 目标从所识读出时，读所识之值的套索假设学习者，其主张经读出，在被列表所持的世界中从辨识的界起静止；它不被给予配置、其数目或目标的任何值。
laws.en: Where the target is read off what is registered, the learner over the lasso hypotheses on the registered values, its claims read off, rests on the target in every world a list holds from the identification bound on; it is given neither the configurations, nor how many there are, nor any value of the target.

laws.zh: 恰当地：在被列表所持的世界中，某个读识的学习者在每个配置上静止，恰当所识的未来相同的配置其目标从某步起一致；必要一侧对每个学习者成立，充分一侧的学习者被给予世界与目标。
laws.en: Exactly: in a world a list holds, some learner reading the registration rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same registered future have targets agreeing from some step on; the necessary side holds of every learner, and the learner of the sufficient side is given the world and the target.

laws.zh: 经识同去的目标总可学；律使每个配置不变时，可学的恰是经识同去者。
laws.en: Targets going alike across the registration are learnable; under a law leaving every configuration unchanged, exactly those are.

laws.zh: 两个坐标、律不变：识第一个坐标时，没有学习者在 (true, false) 与 (true, true) 两处都在第二个坐标上静止，第二个坐标不经第一个同去；识两个坐标时，套索学习者从第 2 步起静止。
laws.en: Two coordinates under a still law: registering the first, no learner rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true), the second not going alike across the first; registering both, the lasso learner rests from step 2.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。所识值的可判定相等（DecidableEq R）只作为套索学习者与 withWorld 的条件，在 rests_through 的陈述与 learnable_iff 的证明中；目标值的可判定相等（DecidableEq V）只在 refuted_on_one。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. Decidable equality of registered values (DecidableEq R) appears only as a condition of the lasso learner and of withWorld, in the statement of rests_through and the proof of learnable_iff; decidable equality of target values (DecidableEq V) only in refuted_on_one.

hypotheses.zh: 每条定理的条件写在其中：所识的未来相同；目标在任意晚处不同；轨道或世界被列表所持；目标从所识读出（val s = g (reg s)）；律使配置不变。
hypotheses.en: Each theorem's conditions are written into it: the same registered future; targets differing at arbitrarily late steps; the orbit or the world held by a list; the target read off the registration (val s = g (reg s)); the law leaving configurations unchanged.

hypotheses.zh: learnable_iff 及其推论中配置在 Type 中（Identification.firstFit 的类型）；其余定理对任意宇宙成立。
hypotheses.en: In learnable_iff and its corollaries the configurations live in Type (the type of Identification.firstFit); the other theorems hold in every universe.

does_not_show.zh: 充分一侧的学习者被给予世界与目标；不被给予什么的学习者只对从现在所识读出的目标证明。
does_not_show.en: The learner of the sufficient side is given the world and the target; a learner given nothing is shown only for targets read off the present registration.

does_not_show.zh: 一般的律下，可学不推出经识同去：读出所识的下一值的目标可学而不必同去。
does_not_show.en: Under a general law, learnable does not imply going alike across the registration: a target reading the next registered value is learnable without it.

does_not_show.zh: 条件关于成对的配置，不是逐配置的；读出它需要知道世界。
does_not_show.en: The condition is on pairs of configurations, not on each; reading it off needs the world.

does_not_show.zh: 学习者仍须分辨所识的值；所识的值本身不被分辨时的学习没有陈述。
does_not_show.en: The learner still tells registered values apart; learning where the registered values themselves are not told apart is not stated.

does_not_show.zh: 与人的学习、神经网络、注意或感知阈限的对应不由此检查。
does_not_show.en: No correspondence to human learning, neural networks, attention or perceptual thresholds is checked.

detail.zh: Pair：识第一个坐标时，没有学习者在 (true, false) 与 (true, true) 两处都在第二个坐标上静止（Pair.first_not_rests）。
detail.en: Pair: registering the first coordinate, no learner rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true) (Pair.first_not_rests).

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261014T091930.724493Z）：Becoming.Learnable 的 23 项声明（17 项定理）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者反审见研究；未经独立审查。

next_delta.zh: 不被给予世界、对每个可学目标静止的学习者，或其不存在的见证；不确定过程上与概率读法下的可学性；实际的识（阈值、注意）的实例；Ren 对“识为所学划界”这一读法的判断。
next_delta.en: A learner given nothing that rests on every learnable target, or a witness that none does; learnability over undetermined processes and on a probabilistic reading; instances for actual registrations (thresholds, attention); Ren's judgment on the reading that registration bounds what is learned.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12：“please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”。按否证学习的结果留下：识不分辨值时的学习没有陈述。本结果陈述它：经识，学习者所能学的，恰是所识的未来相同者从某步起一致之处。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：识为所学划界；依 Ren 的读法，理是对结构与变化之规律的建模，这一建模经识被学到，正如它经识被检验；阈下的差别（依存而不观察的条件只以阈值被识）只在它在所识的未来中显现、或从目标中消失之处可学；识之外者只经扩大识到达：新的观察、他者之识。
correspondence.en: Ren, 12 October 2026: “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. Learning by refutation left learning where registration does not tell values apart unstated. This result states it: what a learner can learn through a registration is exactly where configurations with the same registered future agree from some step on. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): registration bounds what is learned; on Ren's reading 理 is the modeling of the laws of structure and of change, and that modeling is learned through registration as it is tested through it; a difference below threshold (a condition depended on and not observed registers only whether it meets the need) is learnable only where it shows in the registered future or vanishes from the target; what lies beyond registration is reached only by widening it: new observation, another's registration.

detail.zh: 复用 record、record_congr、record_length、Refuted、Lumped、learner、lassos 与 tri：学习者、记录、否证与归并。
detail.en: Reuses record, record_congr, record_length, Refuted, Lumped, learner, lassos and tri: the learner, the record, refutation and lumping.

output.zh: 学习者与所识的记录；按否证学习；归并。
output.en: Learners and registered records; learning by refutation; lumping.

input.zh: 经识的学习者在目标上静止。
input.en: A learner reading a registration resting on a target.

conditions.zh: 套索学习者要所识的值可判定。
conditions.en: The lasso learner needs registered values decided.

detail.zh: 复用 held_learner_rests（未给定界的学习者的静止之步）、Law.name、Law.sameFuture_iff_below、record_eq_iff、firstFit、firstFit_sound 与 firstFit_found。
detail.en: Reuses held_learner_rests (the step at which the learner not given the bound rests), Law.name, Law.sameFuture_iff_below, record_eq_iff, firstFit, firstFit_sound and firstFit_found.

output.zh: 有界的记录确定所识的未来；未给定界的学习者的静止之步。
output.en: A bounded record fixes the registered future; the step at which the learner not given the bound rests.

input.zh: 从所识读出的目标在界内学到；被给予世界的学习者。
input.en: A target read off the registration learned within the bound; the learner given the world.

conditions.zh: 世界或轨道被列表所持。
conditions.en: The world or the orbit held by a list.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.SameFuture：所识的未来相同。
detail.en: Reuses Law.SameFuture: the same registered future.

output.zh: 所识的未来相同的配置。
output.en: Configurations with the same registered future.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.fixed_rests：律不变的配置是它自己的轨道。
detail.en: Reuses Law.fixed_rests: a configuration the law leaves unchanged is its own orbit.

conditions.en: The law leaving the configuration unchanged.

detail.zh: 在不变的律下，可学的目标恰是经识同去者；推广所经的归并就是识所给的那一个。
detail.en: Under a still law, the learnable targets are exactly those going alike across the registration; the lumping generalization goes through is the one the registration gives.

detail.zh: 依存而不观察的条件只以阈值被识；读于学习者，阈下的差别只在它在所识的未来中显现、或从目标中消失之处可学（读法）。
detail.en: A condition depended on and not observed registers only as a threshold; read for learners, a difference below threshold is learnable only where it shows in the registered future or vanishes from the target (a reading).

detail.zh: 其学习一项读于识：学习者所能学的，不多于所识的未来所分辨者。
detail.en: Its learning clause read through registration: a learner learns no more than the registered future tells apart.
